subject: Mutual Action Plan: Security review & SOC 2 evidence for HelioPay — next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@heliopay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Mutual Action Plan & SOC 2 evidence (HelioPay)

Hi Samir / Emily —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone for the security review / SOC 2 evidence so we can align delivery and procurement timelines. I tried to keep dates conservative given your internal approvers.

Key points from today:
- HelioPay will evaluate Redwood for payments-related customer experiences; security review focused on log retention, access controls, and encryption in transit/at-rest.
- You asked for a packaged SOC 2 evidence bundle + completed questionnaire to speed security sign-off.
- We agreed Redwood would take ownership of assembling the evidence we can provide; HelioPay to confirm customer-specific configs and provide any sampling access.

Proposed MAP milestone: Security review & SOC 2 package (draft)
- Target: overall contract close by 2026-10-15
- Questionnaire (HelioPay to answer): due 2026-09-03 (Samir / Emily to confirm security contact)
- Redwood evidence bundle (redacted logs, config screenshots, policy docs): due 2026-09-17 (Karthik / Marissa owners)
- Control walkthrough / 30m sync: week of 2026-09-20 (schedule TBD)
- Final evidence handoff + procurement sign-off: 2026-10-01 -> legal/PO work to follow

Responsibilities (draft):
- HelioPay: assign security reviewer and answer questionnaire; provide any environment-specific endpoints or samples we should analyze.
- Redwood: provide completed SOC 2 questionnaire template, compile evidence index, produce redacted logs and screenshots, coordinate control walkthrough.

Attachments sent with this email: [attachment: redwood_soc2-questionnaire-v1.pdf (pdf)], [attachment: evidence-index-template.xlsx (xlsx)], [attachment: mutual-action-plan-draft.docx (docx)].

Next steps:
1) Samir / Emily: confirm security reviewer + agree to the questionnaire due date (2026-09-03)
2) Jordan / Karthik / Marissa: begin evidence collection and propose 2 slots for the walkthrough the week of 2026-09-20

Happy to adjust dates if your procurement/compliance windows are tighter.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai] | +1 (415) 555-0132

--
On the call: Samir Khan (HelioPay), Emily Chen (HelioPay), Jordan Blake (Redwood), Karthik Iyer (Redwood), Marissa Cole (Redwood).

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@heliopay.com>

Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:03:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Mutual Action Plan & SOC 2 evidence (HelioPay)

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear recap. We want to move quickly; two clarifications from our side before we commit to the dates:

1) Data retention/logs: can Redwood provide an export of redacted request logs covering the sample window (we'd like 30 days) and an explanation of retention policy for customer telemetry? We also need to confirm whether logs include customer identifiers (we prefer redacted).
2) Evidence ownership: for items marked as "Redwood to provide," will those be packaged in a single ZIP with an index, or do you expect us to pull documents from your Drive link?

Also, our security lead (Emily) will be out of office next week; I can take the questionnaire but will loop Emily and our infra lead if we need deep config detail. If you can push the questionnaire to Sep 07 instead of Sep 03, that's safer for us.

Subject: Re: Next steps: Mutual Action Plan & SOC 2 evidence (HelioPay)

Samir —

Thanks for the quick reply and the note about Emily being OOO. We can accommodate a Sep 07 due date for the questionnaire. Quick answers to your two questions below and a short plan for evidence delivery.

1) Logs / retention: Redwood retains request logs for customer API calls for 90 days by default. For the redacted export we will:
   - Provide a 30-day sample export with all PII/customer identifiers removed (we'll hash IDs and include a mapping key kept internally).
   - Include a short README describing retention policy and log schema.

2) Evidence delivery format: we'll assemble a single evidence bundle (ZIP) with an index (evidence-index-template.xlsx) and upload to a shared Drive folder. Each item in the index will note redaction status and access controls.

Proposed updated milestone dates (per Samir request):
- Questionnaire: 2026-09-07 (HelioPay answers)
- Redwood evidence bundle uploaded to Drive: 2026-09-21
- Control walkthrough: 2026-09-24 (30 min)
- Final evidence handoff for procurement: 2026-10-01

Owners (confirmed):
- HelioPay: Samir Khan (security lead) + Emily Chen (infra reviewer)
- Redwood: Karthik Iyer (evidence assembly), Marissa Cole (compliance coordination), Jordan Blake (sales / procurement liaison)

Attachments I just uploaded: [attachment: evidence-index-template.xlsx (xlsx)] — use this to map items. We'll include redwood_soc2-questionnaire-v1.pdf in the Drive too.

If that works I can create the Drive folder and post the link.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
